test_loc_getitem_label: test label-based getitem indexing on DataFrame and Series with scalar, list, and slice keys
test_loc_setitem_scalar: test label-based setitem assignment with scalar values on DataFrame columns and rows
test_loc_setitem_slice: test label-based setitem with slice keys including datetime and timedelta index slices
test_loc_multiindex_getitem: test label-based indexing with MultiIndex keys including tuple levels and partial slicing
test_loc_setitem_expansion: test label-based setitem that expands DataFrame or Series by adding new rows or columns
